svg.text: 100,000 gateways plus the 500,000 devices behind them · a gateway is a device, so it has an actor too

g.text: a gateway message naming a device
the actor is created on first reference —
the announce is the common case, not the only one

svg.text: every core instance runs its own App Actor, and under it a tenant actor for every tenant in its partitions — here all five
open up one of the thirty

g.text: Tenant A actor · core-1 · A's devices in p0, p1
one message at a time · single-threaded
a device lookup sits in the creation path — slow while the cache is still cold
only now does the actor take the next device

svg.text: strictly sequential — one device in flight at a time
this is the constraint, and no single stream can be made faster
30 of these run at the same time · 6 core instances × 5 tenants
a naive single-instance, single-tenant deployment has exactly one · a stream cannot be made faster, only multiplied
